Implemented + independently re-verified (Ghidra 12.1.2 headless, banktest2 + banktest regression). Per-bit PortState(knownMask,bits) replaces the int state: dataflow merge keeps agreeing known bits only (monotone shrink, terminating); store resolution = backward mask-algebra scan with (aAcc,oAcc) accumulators composing AND#imm/ORA#imm, terminating at LDA#imm (fully known), a load of the mechanism address itself (base = tracked in-state — so LDA $01/AND #$FE/STA $01 from known state 5 resolves EXACTLY to 4), or any clobber incl. crossing calls (review fix: JSR fall-through passes the block-linkage check, so calls must clobber explicitly) and crossing mechanism writes (abort, unsound to inherit). Occupant resolution assumes initial_state for unknown bits (user fallback); partial switches get 'bank -> 7? (...) [known: LORAM=1; assumed from initial: HIRAM,CHAREN]' comments; WARNING bookmark only when NO bank bit is known. INFRA FINDING (step 0): SymbolicPropogator/VarnodeContext track whole register values — LDA $01 (unknown memory) poisons the chain; no per-bit partial-knowledge model exists in-tree, so the mask algebra is necessary, not a workaround. All 6 banktest2 criteria + 4 banktest regression criteria pass.
